title: Somebody Lives Here
setup: {name} reaches {place}. A candle in the kitchen, a cough upstairs. The medicine cabinet is by the back door.

options.label: Knock and offer to trade

then.text: They traded a bottle of water for news from the street.

else.text: Nobody answered. The cough stopped while {name} waited.

options.outcome: {name} knocks twice and waits on the step with empty hands.

options.label: Leave them be
options.outcome: {name} walks on. Somebody upstairs never knows how close it was.

options.label: Take their medicine while they sleep
options.outcome: The cabinet opens without a sound. {name} doesn't look at the photos on the fridge.

options.label: Take everything at gunpoint
options.outcome: They hand it over without a word. The neighbourhood will hear about this.
